root_cause: LinkedIn personal publication had a durable provider post id plus successful create acknowledgement, but later GET_POST_CONTENT readback returned a permission-limited 403. The recovery runner required provider_truth_verified=true for every channel, contradicting the canonical publisher contract that a confirmed personal LinkedIn create side effect is authoritative and must never be republished merely because later readback permissions are narrower.
prevention_rule: Recovery GREEN keeps exact provider readback as the default. Only linkedin_personal may satisfy provider side-effect truth without exact readback, and only when provider_create_success=true, provider_publication_ack_verified=true, readback_permission_limited=true, republish_forbidden=true, and a durable external_id exists. LinkedIn company and Instagram continue to require exact provider_truth_verified=true.
